Gold_Standard_clean_text: SHapley Additive exPlanation (SHAP) (Lundberg & Lee, 2017) is a method for interpreting the results of machine learning by computing the contribution of each feature and represents the outcome of patient-j: f(x(j)) as the sum of each features-i’s contribution φi(x(j)i). f(x(j)) = φ0 + XKi=1 φi(x(j)i) (1) φ0 = 1/N XNj=1 f(x(j)) (2) φi(x(j)i) = Φ(x(j)i) − 1/N XNk=1 Φ(xi(k)) (3), where N is the number of patients and Φ(xi) is the Shapley value for xi.
The Shapley value is defined as follows: Φ(x_i) = ∑_{S ⊆ {1,…,K} \ {i}} |S|!(K−|S|−1)! / K! [f_x(S ∪ {i}) − f_x(S)], where K is the number of stakeholders or features.
